clips.title: The story
paras: At Klaven's Tower in Westfall, the Defias Tower Key proves an infiltrator reached the guarded perimeter. Stormwind operatives seek it from the malformed drones outside.

Klaven's Tower stands on the Westfall coast as a Defias Brotherhood stronghold. Recent shipments from Duskwood brought new guards to its perimeter: malformed Defias drones, undead and covered in spikes. SI:7 operatives watch the grounds and direct field agents to pick the pockets of these sentries. Fighting them head-on is not the way to prove the perimeter has been breached. The key shows an infiltrator got through without raising an alarm.
